mcp:tool-listener.name: get_property_details
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: get_property_details - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Get the full profile of ONE Ascott property: name, brand, photos, address and map coordinates, getting there, amenities and facilities, check-in and check-out times, awards, nearby places and its lead-in nightly price for the stay. Use it when the user asks about a specific property ("tell me about Ascott Raffles Place"). Identify the property by propertyCode (resolve it from the property name first). If the user mentions children, ask their ages before calling: childAges, one per child, is required when noOfchildren is above 0. For the list of room types and rates use get_room_rate_details; for its facilities as services use get_service_offerings. The lead-in price is the cheapest rate as the property quotes it and may exclude taxes; quote exact totals only from create_booking. Read-only: it creates, holds and changes nothing.

mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: get_room_rate_details - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: List every room type available at ONE Ascott property for a stay, with all its bookable rate plans: nightly and total price, taxes, cancellation terms, points earned, size, bed type, occupancy, photos and amenities. Several rooms can be searched at once: send one apartmentList entry per room with that room's guests; the result has one room list per requested room, in the same order. Prices are on each rate's own tax basis: when is_tax_inclusive is false, add per_night_tax / total_tax for the all-in price. Rates are sorted cheapest first and room types by the property's ranking. Use room_code and rate_plan_code from this result for compare_rooms_rates and create_booking. Read-only: it holds and books nothing.

mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: get_promotions - Tool Listener

mcp:tool-listener.name: create_booking
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: create_booking - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Prepare the checkout for one or more rooms at ONE Ascott property: re-check that each room and rate is still bookable now and return a booking summary (rooms, rates, guests, stay, total price including taxes, points) that the widget turns into a discoverasr.com checkout link, where the user enters their details and pays. Send one apartmentList entry per room with that room's guests and, when the user picked them, roomCode and ratePlanCode from get_room_rate_details or compare_rooms_rates for THAT room; without them the cheapest bookable rate is chosen (meta.resolution says which). If a picked rate is no longer available the call fails and its message lists what is; offer those instead. Quote totals only from meta.total_stay_price.

set-variable.value: #[vars.publicError default {category: 'TECHNICAL', code: 'DOWNSTREAM_ERROR', message: 'The property service could not complete this request.', retryable: (vars.xapiStatus default 500) >= 500}]

raise-error.description: #[vars.publicError.message default 'The property service rejected the request.']
